messages:
alex: Morning — quick sync. We're planning the v2.3.1 release tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need console copy + SDK docs regen to match the version bump. Who can own the docs deploy?
miriam: I can take console copy edits. Where's the final changelog?
alex: @devon pushed the changelog PR last night — PR #482. It's waiting on one review. Can someone please approve?
devon: pinged reviewers. CI had a flaky matrix job, re-ran it.
sophia: I can do the SDK docs regen after lunch. What's the exact command and branch?
alex: Branch is `release/v2.3.1`. For SDK regen you can run: `scripts/regen_sdk_docs.sh --branch release/v2.3.1` or `npm run docs:regen -- --branch=release/v2.3.1`.
alex: Also need to bump console package version to `2.3.1` in `console/package.json` and add the changelog link to the top nav.
gina: I'll do the package bump and nav change. Will open a tiny PR and tag @miriam for copy review.
miriam: thanks. After that PR merges we need to trigger the docs site deploy. @deploy-bot can you schedule the window?
deploy-bot: deploy window requested: 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. Reply with `yes` to confirm.
alex: Confirmed. Can we do a staged rollout? If staging looks good, promote to prod after 30m.
devon: Giving the changelog PR one last look now.
sophia: Quick SDK note: update the sample in quickstart to `const client = new Redwood({ version: "2.3.1" })` so examples match.
miriam: Also add a short entry in `release-notes.md` under both "Console" and "SDK".
alex: Timeline for clarity — PRs merged by 12:00 PT, docs regen finished by 14:00 PT, deploy window 16:00Z. If anything slips ping @sre-oncall as backup.
gina: PR opened: #490 — assigning @miriam and @devon.
miriam: reviewed, pushed a tiny wording fix.
devon: CI is green. Merging now.
alex: Merged. @sophia can you start the SDK regen?
sophia: starting now. Logs below:
```bash
scripts/regen_sdk_docs.sh --branch release/v2.3.1
# output: generation complete, 45 files updated
```
sophia: pushed docs update PR #492 (includes quickstart update + examples).
miriam: copy checks out. @deploy-bot — confirm deploy window?
deploy-bot: yes — deploy scheduled for 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. Notifying eng-sre channel.
alex: Thanks all. I'll monitor the deploy channel. If regressions appear revert plan is to rollback to `stable/2.3.0` and pin traffic. :thumbsup: 
gina: quick follow-up — added migration notes link under SDK changelog section.
miriam: done.
alex: OK closing this thread — we'll post the final release notes after deploy. :rocket:
